## Spec

IntegrationSpec is one independently elected background integration.

Validation: cloudflare settings must match type (`has(self.cloudflare) == (self.type == 'cloudflare')`)

Validation: unifi settings must match type (`has(self.unifi) == (self.type == 'unifi')`)

Validation: webhook settings must match type (`has(self.webhook) == (self.type == 'webhook')`)

Validation: cloudflare requires an apiToken credential reference (`self.type != 'cloudflare' || (has(self.credentials) && 'apiToken' in self.credentials)`)

Validation: unifi requires an apiKey credential reference (`self.type != 'unifi' || (has(self.credentials) && 'apiKey' in self.credentials)`)

| `status.clients` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |

| `status.lastSyncTime` | `string` | Format: `date-time` |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |
| `status.records` | `object` | IntegrationRecordCounts describes the last publication plan. |
| `status.records.conflicts` | `integer` | **Required.**<br>Format: `int64`<br>Range: at least 0 |
| `status.records.drift` | `integer` | **Required.**<br>Format: `int64`<br>Range: at least 0 |
| `status.records.managed` | `integer` | **Required.**<br>Format: `int64`<br>Range: at least 0 |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_integration.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: Integration
metadata:
  name: public-dns
  namespace: default
spec:
  type: cloudflare
  credentials:
    apiToken:
      secretRef:
        name: cloudflare-token
        key: token
  cloudflare:
    zones:
      - zone: example.com
        select:
          labels:
            kudurru.io/publish: cloudflare
          types: [A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV, CAA]
        defaults:
          proxied: false
          ttl: 1
        policy: sync
  deletionPolicy: Retain
  resync: 10m
  suspend: true
```
